description: MRI protocols standardized across all 60+ sites with MP-RAGE, FLAIR, T2 sequences
Sites must complete certification process before participating in ADNI data collection
Monthly phantom scanning at each site to monitor scanner stability
Centralized quality control of all imaging data at LONI before release
Systematic tracking of missing visits with reasons documented
Clinical raters trained and certified on CDR and cognitive assessment scales
CSF and plasma assays performed at standardized labs with QC samples
PET reads performed by certified readers using standardized protocols
Genotyping quality controlled with call rate thresholds and replicate samples
Study partner required for all participants to verify longitudinal compliance
